text:
Sam: heads-up — we're seeing an uptick in egress retries from us-east2 to eu-west1 starting ~12:05UTC, looks like LB connection churn. posting quick triage.
incident-bot: Alert: upstream-retry-rate > 5% for service=api-gateway region=us-east2 threshold=5% (triggered at 1781239876)
Kiran: grabbing metrics now. initial look: 502s and TLS handshake timeouts spiking around the same window, also a small bump in socket resets.
Marta: any config changes in the last 24h? I remember a routing policy tweak yesterday for canary traffic.
Kiran: yes — we rolled a change to cross-region routing weights 18h ago (change-id: rth-2026-03-22-7). I'll correlate.
Jonah: this feels like the pattern from the mid-Feb incidents where cross-region TLS sessions didn't fully close and retries piled up. If it's the same class, we need a longer-term fix not just a rollback.
Alexa: agree. short-term: suggests we pin routing weights back to baseline for the next 2 hours to stabilize. action items below.
Sam: action items (will capture here):
- A1: Kiran to validate if rth-2026-03-22-7 correlates with spike and surface exact commit + config (due: 2026-03-22 13:00UTC)
- A2: Marta to apply temporary weight pin on cross-region policy (baseline) and monitor (due: 2026-03-22 12:50UTC)
- A3: Jonah to run deeper session-trace and check for stale TLS sessions / FIN handling across LB (due: 2026-03-22 15:00UTC)
- A4: Alexa to draft postmortem follow-ups and owner assignments for recurrence (due: 2026-03-24)
Kiran: starting correlation now. snippet from tcpdump around 12:07:
```
12:07:14.123456 IP client->lb: Flags [S], seq 0
12:07:14.223987 IP lb->upstream: Flags [S], seq 0
12:07:14.523001 IP client->lb: Flags [R], seq 1  # client reset
12:07:14.623450 TLS handshake failure: alert handshake_failure
```
Kiran: prelim: several handshakes failing then immediate client RSTs — suggests upstream negotiated algo mismatch or backend started rejecting sessions. correlation with routing weight change in progress.
Marta: pinned weights to baseline at 12:49UTC. initial dashboards show retry-rate dropping ~40% in first 6m.
Jonah: will run correlation against the LB SNI logs + backend cert timeline. also will check kernel tcp_fin_timeout skew across the pool.
Alexa: for postmortem items I propose:
- Root cause hypothesis to validate (routing weight + backend TLS mismatch)
- Short-term mitigations (weight pin + circuit-breaker on TLS errors)
- Medium-term: add e2e TLS compatibility tests in the canary pipeline + LB connection draining improvements
- Ownership: Kiran (config rollback validation), Eng-Infrastructure (Marta) for policy tooling, Eng-Runtime (Jonah) for connection handling, Product Eng (Alexa) for rollout gating
Sam: can we set a biweekly recurring review for cross-region LB anomalies until we have the medium-term fixes? last three incidents were ~Feb 12, Mar 3, Mar 22. pattern looks periodic with deploy windows.
Marta: +1. I'll add a recurring 30m sync on Wednesdays, invite owners.
incident-bot: Note: created incident ticket INC-2026-1842 (linked).
Kiran: Updated A1: confirmed the change-id_commit=ab9f3c4 did adjust weights and coincides with the first metric uptick 8m after deploy. attaching commit diff (summary): changed route selection order for eu-west1 fallback.
Jonah: quick note — found ~120 stale TLS sessions on one backend host (pid 4211) — tracing suggests FIN not being forwarded on abrupt shuffles. posting dump in the incident ticket.
Alexa: I'll own the write-up. tentative timeline: draft by 2026-03-23, review with infra and runtime on 2026-03-24. will include rollback criteria and a test matrix.
Sam: thanks all. follow-ups: everyone update the incident ticket with concrete evidence before EOD. We'll keep this thread for ownership check-ins only. :thumbsup:
Marta: noted, will update with monitoring thresholds and the pinning runbook.
Kiran: will post final correlation matrix and signal graphs in the ticket.
Jonah: prepping a short repro script for the FIN handling case — will attach to the ticket and link to a small e2e test job.
Alexa: adding owners to the postmortem doc now and assigning action items in the tracker.
Sam: moving to monitoring: can we add an alert for TLS-handshake-failure-rate > 2% and cross-region retry increase > 3% so we catch earlier?
Marta: yes, I'll propose thresholds and a runbook update in the next hour.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-1842 transitioned to status=investigating at 1781239902
Sam: closing loop — plan is: short-term pin (done), diagnostics (in progress), medium-term fixes (e2e + connection draining) tracked by owners. weekly checkins for recurrence until fixes merged. I'll ping this thread for the 24h check-in.
Alexa: +1, will consolidate action items and set reminders.
Jonah: on it.
Sam: thanks team, everyone stay on the ticket for details. :coffee:
